---
name: Content correction (French or Spanish)
about: Something on a page is wrong — an error in the French, a wrong Spanish gloss, a wrong fact
title: '[content] '
labels: content
---

**Page**
Which lesson or drill, and the URL or file path.

**What it says now**
Quote the text as it stands.

**What it should say**
The correction.

**Why**
A rule, a reference, or just "native speaker, this is not how it is said" — all are fine.

**How certain are you?**
Certain / fairly sure / worth checking. Please say — a confident wrong correction in teaching
material is harder to catch later than the original error, so an honest "worth checking" is more
useful than a guess presented as fact.
